title: Closing a page item also writes its receipt and deletes its answer, so no answer shows "filing pending" after the item is filed
why: Owner 13:26 CST Nov 13 (typed in this session): "im seeing a fuck ton of answered with filing pending in the artifact". Measured by triage at that time: 276 answers, 180 receipts; 250 answers had no receipt (33 on open items, 217 on closed items from Nov 6 to Nov 13).
source: owner, 13:26 CST Nov 13; triage read of the page database
note: Todo, a mistake with a missing guard (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Cause: skill waiting-page says Route and close writes receipts/<id> (read, filed), copies the answer into lastAnswer, closes the item and deletes answers/<id>. Triage (the writer) closed items with status closed and a reply only, so the page kept reading "Filing pending". 19 of the 33 open ones are triage's own; 14 belong to the coordinator and lanes, whose sessions never wrote receipts. Fixed now for the 10 answers of 13:20 to 13:22 CST. Not fixed: the other 240, which need a ledger, since a receipt says "filed in <home>" and each home must be read first (bulk-close-needs-ledger). Guard to build: a check or helper so one write closes an item, writes its receipt and deletes its answer together; a read that lists answers with no receipt at each wake (the `--unread` check reads only `read`). Second gap, owner 13:29 CST Nov 13 (item 715): a lane waits on a page item, but the item names no lane (its `lane` field was empty), so an answer routes to the item's `owner` (triage) and never to the waiting lane. Item 715 also held a "none of these" question since 11:53 CST with no reply and no receipt, so the owner thought he had answered and the lane never heard. Fix: (1) an item that blocks a lane carries that lane in `lane`, set when the item is posted; (2) the wake that reads answers also messages that lane; (3) a "none" answer that asks a question gets a written reply on the item and a receipt the same wake; (4) the unread check lists answers with no receipt for every item, whatever its owner. EXPRESS, owner 13:32 CST Nov 13 (typed: "that fix needs an express lane"; ruling own-receipt-fix-express). Ready for a lane now, ahead of the drain. Scope in this order: (1) one write closes an item, writes its receipt and deletes its answer; (2) an item that blocks a lane carries that lane, and the wake that reads answers messages it; (3) a question answer gets a written reply and a receipt in the same wake; (4) the unread check lists every answer with no receipt, whatever the item owner. A check or helper change: test-author red cases first, builder, reviewer. Express lane started 13:36 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 13:36 CST): lane session_013NEJL3o4VZAch2NXdx3diD. Lane question 15:44 CST Nov 13 (lane receipt-close-express, #3264 head 14f58eb41; lane's read, unmeasured): `merge --lane-lint 3264` FAILs because in run 43510710739 the Windows job step "Run the touched PowerShell tests" was cancelled after about 2 min (the lane touches no PowerShell file) and the macOS job is still queued. The lane asks whether it or the coordinator may re-run the failed jobs. Routed to the coordinator; the lane waits and pushes no empty commit. A cancel at 2 min is not the 10 min cap fault; the GitHub quota was exhausted twice today.
